According to non-diffraction theory and anomalous reflection law, two metasurfaces are designed for comparison. The simulation results show that the designed metasurfaces successfully realize the non-diffractive beam with a focusing distance of 126 mm (2.44 λ<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</sub>), and can bend the normally reflected wave to the direction 10° from the +z direction in a vertical plane 45° away from the +x direction. The average efficiency of the metasurface within the focusing range is as high as 84.5%, thus could be used as radio energy transmission, telecommunication multiplexing and accurate detection devices.

articleTitle: A Wideband Open TEM cell to Measure the Frequency Response of a Frequency Selective Surface
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: A simple system for the measurement of scattering parameters is presented utilizing an open Transverse Electro-Magnetic (TEM) cell. The scattering parameters are simulated in the principle of Finite Differences Time Domain (FDTD). Meanwhile, a classical slot Frequency Selective Surface (FSS) was simulated in the proposed TEM cell, and the results are in greet agreement with the full-wave simulated results in unit cell way. The simulation result shows a good field uniformity and low reflection in the frequency range of 1 to 8 GHz, which may be applied in absorptivity measurement of absorber, transmission and reflection coefficient of FSS, Frequency Selective Rasorber (FSR).

articleTitle: Spoof Surface Plasmon Polaritons Supported by Substrate Integrated Waveguide with Arrays of Holes
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: This paper presents an approach to develop spoof surface plasmon polaritons (SSPPs) in substrate integrated waveguides (SIWs) with simple geometries (arrays of rectangular holes). Dispersion properties of both SSPPs based on a SIW with a rectangular hole and the traditional SSPPs based on a single-conductor metallic strip with the same hole are compared. Moreover, a smooth transition built by stepped impedance transmission lines with gradient holes is designed for high-efficiency mode conversion. Consequently, an SSPP waveguide is constructed by a SIW with uniform holes and the proposed transition, and the frequency responses of the waveguide are simulated for validation. The simulated bandwidth can reach as up to 100.1% covering a range from 4.34 to 13.05 GHz, which agrees well with the dispersion diagram.

articleTitle: Implementation and Comparison of Signal Detection Methods in Radar Reconnaissance System
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: The real-time signal detection is the important foundation to guarantee interception to radar signal in radar reconnaissance system. With development of low detectable radar, waveform of large time-bandwidth products are more and more widely applied. Radar can achieve high compression processing gain through pulse compression technique. For radar reconnaissance system, different signal detection methods may lead to different detection performance of radar signal. This paper conducts analysis to signal waveform in typical existing radar modes and different signal detection methods, provides one estimation system for detection performance and makes comparison to the detection methods accordingly.

articleTitle: An One-dimensional Holographic Antenna For RFID Reader
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: A one-dimensional holographic metasurface antenna that can achieve full-angle symmetrical dual-beam rapid scanning while keeping its position unchanged is proposed. The principle of holographic antenna and beam deflection control is introduced. The simulation results are consistent with the expected results.

articleTitle: Unmanned Noise Reduction Method of Micro-Electro-Mechanical System Inertial Measurement Unit Based on Improved EMD
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: The traditional Fourier algorithm cannot fix the problem of non-stationary noise deduction for MEMS-IMU, therefore this article uses Empirical Mode Decomposition (EMD) algorithm to denoise the signal. In this article, Extreme Learning Machine (ELM) is combined to reduce the influence of end effect in the decomposition. First, the MEMS-IMU simulate signal generated by matlab is taken as the test object, and EMD as well as ELM extension decomposition are carried out for it respectively. The decomposition noise reduction effect is compared and analyzed to study the role of EMD and ELM in the process. Second, carry out a test on the authentically measured MEMS-IMU signal. In de-noising the MEMS-IMU simulate signal and authentic signal, we can analyze the noise deduction effect and observe the changes of parameters related to random error. The results show that the method based on ELM and EMD can achieve good noise reduction effect for MEMS signal.

articleTitle: Research On Wireless Local Area Network In Large Scale Manned Spacecraft
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Reference to the widely used wireless local area network(WLAN) in daily life, And in order to meet the requirements in office, inventory management, supports in experiment and equipment maintenance on orbit, the implementation scheme of WLAN based on WiFi(Wireless Fidelity) in long-term large scale manned spacecraft is proposed here, the explanation about the interconnected equipment such as crew laptop computer, wireless audio terminal, RFID(Radio Frequency Identification), wireless barcode recorder, experiment crack, camera and monitor which provide service and support for the space mission is presented in detail.

articleTitle: Design of Non-uniform Flexible Meta-surface for Antenna Beam-steering
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Design of non-uniform flexible meta-surface for antenna beam-steering is presented in this paper. By properly tuning the dimensions of quasi-I-shaped unit cells on meta-surface, we propose a bi-layer meta-surface that can achieve beam deflection of up to 34°. Horn antenna is adopted as the feed antenna to illuminate the meta-surface which is printed on flexible plastic sheet. The meta-surface is fixed on the outside surface of horn antenna with an electric motor, making it possible to slide relative to the aperture of feed antenna. The horn antenna together with the meta-surface will work like a projector when operating, the main-beam of the horn antenna can be steered when different frames of the meta-surface cover the horn aperture and the steering range is ±34°. Radiation reconfigurable is thus achieved through a simple structure. Prototype will be fabricated in the following research.

articleTitle: The Response of Fiber-Reinforced Laminates to Polarized THz Electromagnetic waves
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: The focus of this paper is on the scattering properties of the fiber-reinforced composite materials to polarized THz electromagnetic wave, which serves for applying THz wave to non-destructive testing of the fiber-reinforced composites. A two-layer stack is considered as a basic lamina for constructing the laminates by stacking up one by another. The fibers in each layer of the two-layer stack is orientated into arbitrary directions. An incident THz electric field as a particular case with arbitrary polarization direction with respect to the propagation direction is considered. The mode matching method based on plane wave and cylindrical wave expansions is applied for studying the reflection properties of the firber-reinforced composites. The contribution of electric field components un-parallel to the lamina surface are automatically included via Maxwell's equations and mode matching. Several numerical examples are presented, and the reflection properties of the periodic fiber-reinforced laminates to polarized THz waves are investigated in detail.

articleTitle: Inter-Satellite Broadcast Topology Planning Method for Walker Constellation Using TDMA Link
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In order to improve the data communication capacity and response speed of walker constellation such as global navigation constellation, scientific planning of the Inter-Satellite Link (ISL) topology is needed. Focusing on one kind of walker constellation using Time Division Multiple Access (TDMA) link as ISL, this paper proposes analyses on the geometric topology relation of Continuous Visible ISL (CVISL), based on which establishes K-cycle topology planning model, provides some optimal planning strategies for CVISL, and realizes multi-hops broadcast communication and effective operation of TDMA link. The model is proved by simulation that can improve the capacity of data broadcasting and automatic operation of the constellation.

articleTitle: A Multiple-Input Multiple-Output Antenna Array with Low Mutual Coupling Using Baffle Structures
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: A 2×4 dual-polarized multiple-input-multiple-output (MIMO) array with baffle structures is proposed for 5G base station application. The baffle is composed of two metal split ring resonators (SRRs) printed on a 1-mm thick FR4 substrate. It works as band-stop filter which can block the coupling waves from different directions within the array. Some modifications are also made on the ground to further improve the array performance. Simulated results show that the mutual coupling for both the cross-polarization and co-polarization can be reduced to almost −25 dB or lower in 3.4-3.8 GHz.

articleTitle: Airy beam generation and manipulation utilizing metasurface
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In this paper, a new method to generate and control one-dimensional Airy beam based on metasurface is proposed. By controlling the length and rotation angle of the unit cell structures, the amplitude and phase of the transmission coefficient can be adjusted to excite the desired one-dimensional Airy beam with obvious self-bending phenomenon. Full-amplitude modulation method and simplified-amplitude modulation method are utilized and discussed here. In addition, the method to regulate the deflection of the main lobe of the one-dimensional Airy beam is proposed by changing the number of elements in the metasurfaces array. The calculated and experimental results show good agreement with each other, and the proposed metasurface-based Airy beam generator can be widely applied in wireless energy transmission and underground exploration systems.

articleTitle: Deep Learning based Short Term Load Prediction in Smart Grids
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Short-term load prediction as a basic work of operation and control in power system plays an important role for power operation and scheduling, motor start-stop, etc. 5th generation (5G) communications technologies make the size of data in smart grids larger, compared to non-5G equipped smart grid. To cope with this challenge, we propose a daily time step-by-step load prediction method based on deep learning. A deep cycle neural network (DCNN) model is established for the total daily load and hourly load of users. Through simulation, superiority of our work is proved.

articleTitle: A Method Based on Metasurface to Reduce the Measurement Uncertainty in Reverberation Chamber
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In this paper, a type of polarization-insensitive metasurface to improve the independent sample number of reverberation chamber is proposed. The metasurface has high reflection amplitude (almost equal to 1) and wide phase range (ranges from +148° to -327°). By applying the metasurface, the reflection phases of symmetric metal walls are changed as well as the boundary condition of the reverberation chamber. The independent sample number is used to describe the measurement uncertainty of the reverberation chamber. A comparison of independent sample number amongst four reverberation chambers with different metasurfaces is carried out. It is found that reverberation chamber with metasurface that has the largest phase difference over frequency-band shows the best performance in terms of measurement uncertainty.

articleTitle: Use OFDM In OAM Communication to Redcuce Multi-path Effects
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: The orbital angular momentum (OAM) has raised great attention for its potential to enhance the capacity of wireless communication system. The performance of OAM communication is dependent on the accuracy of phase information. In multi-path channel, the accuracy is destroyed. In this paper, we use orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (OFDM)before OAM modulation to enhance communication performance.

articleTitle: An electronic scanning leaky-wave antenna based on the half-mode corrugated integrated waveguide
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: An electronic scanning leaky-wave antenna based on the half-mode corrugated integrated waveguide is proposed in this paper. Electronic scanning is achieved by the employment of varactor diodes. The scanning angle ranges from -24°to +38°continuously at 5.8 GHz, and the gain is greater than 6 dB at all scanning angles. Meanwhile, the circular polarization is achieved by two symmetrical bent slots and the axial ratio is lower than 6 dB. Because of the advantage of half-mode corrugated integrated waveguide, this kind of antenna is compact and beneficial to be applied in some devices without via hole.

articleTitle: Image Based Localization Algorithm Using Similarity Measurements and Back-Propagation Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In this paper, an image based localization technique is proposed by similarity measurements and back-propagation neural network (BPNN). First, the bilinear interpolation method is used for size normalization of the obtained images. Then, the relative distance is calculated as the label of each collection position. The image similarity measurements, such as cosine, Hist and SSIM similarity are chosen as the fingerprint of the collection position. At last, the BPNN is utilized for regression learning and obtain the distance based regression function. Field tests show that the proposed algorithm can obtain more accurate position estimation than other existing image based localization approaches.

articleTitle: A Segment CRC Scheme for Polar Codes
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In this paper, segment cyclic redundancy check (CRC) scheme for polar codes is discussed. Motivated by the non-monotonic property of the first error probabilities of bit-channels used for transmitting information bits and the sequential decoding property of list successive cancellation (LSC) decoding, we propose a segment CRC scheme for polar codes. Both the principle for dividing information sequence into multiple subsequences and decoding procedure are discussed. The analysis shows that the segment CRC scheme can improve the BLER performance of polar codes, reduce the decoding complexity with the cost of undetected error probability compared with conventional CRC scheme. The simulation results verify our analysis. Besides, we also show how different CRC combinations effect the BLER performance of polar codes by simulation. And the simulation result suggests that the last CRC in the CRC combination must be strong in order to find the correct path in the list.

articleTitle: Ray-Tracing Based Multi-Frequency Large-Scale Channel Characterization for Indoor Millimeter Wave Communications
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: The millimeter wave has received extensive attention because of its abundant spectrum resources. However, millimeter wave wireless communication systems face problems such as large frequency differences, small coverage areas, and high deployment costs. Therefore, it is urgent to complete millimeter wave wireless channel measurement and modeling for multiple scenarios. This paper first introduces the mainstream 5G millimeter wave candidate frequency bands and application scenarios. Then, based on the commercial ray-tracing simulation tools, the large-scale propagation characteristics for the indoor millimeter wave channel across multiple typical frequency bands are investigated. Finally, simulation results show that the large-scale path loss and angle spread strongly depend on carrier frequencies and antenna positions.

articleTitle: Robust Multi-kernel Generalized Maximum Correntropy Filters
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: The traditional multi-kernel filtering algorithms are proposed by combining multiple kernel with the second similarity measure. Nevertheless, these multi-kernel filters suffer from both heavy computation burden and divergence for impulsive noise environments. To deal with these challenges for online applications, the multi-kernel generalized maximum correntropy (MKGMC) algorithm is developed for improving both precision and stability under the generalized maximum correntropy criterion. To alleviate the complex network structure of MKGMC, using the vector quantization strategy in MKGMC develops quantized MKGMC (QMKGMC) to reduce the computational and spatial complexity. From the viewpoints of precision and stability, the proposed algorithms outperform other typical compared algorithms on time series prediction.

articleTitle: A Flexible Wearable Linear-to-Circular Polarizer for GNSS Application
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: This paper presents a single-layered fabric-based flexible linear-to-circular polarizer for GNSS application operating at 1.575 GHz. The structure presented here is based on a square aperture with an E-shaped patch structure on the reverse side. The size of the structure is 0. 21λ<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</sub> ×0. 26λ<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</sub> × 0. 01λ<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</sub> The complete structure is flexible, and the frequency of operation is centered at 1.575 GHz, with a minimum value of the axial ratio achieved is 0.06 dB. The 3 dB axial ratio fractional bandwidth is 3.81% (1.54-1.60 GHz) and the conversion efficiency fractional bandwidth covering 90% is 5.09% (1.53 to 1.61 GHz).

articleTitle: Extraction Technology of Line of Sight Angular Velocity with Missile Rolling
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: When the missile is rolling, the roll angular velocity of missile will be coupled with the stable platform of seeker, causing the output of the seeker gyro has an additional signal related to the roll angular velocity of missile based on the real LOS (line of sight) angular velocity. Based on the principle of LOS synthesis, the coupling mechanism between the LOS angular velocity of the two frame seeker and the roll angular velocity of the missile is analyzed. In order to eliminate the coupling effect, the Kalman filter technology is used to extract the LOS angular velocity, and the Kalman filter equation is established, which is verified by simulation. The results show that the missile roll movement affects the gyro output, and the extraction of LOS angular velocity by Kalman filter technology can meet the requirements of guidance information accuracy.

articleTitle: A Holographic Metasurface for Microwave Power Transmission Applications
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Microwave power transmission has become a hot research topic in recent years. To overcome the constrain of traditional MPT techniques, a holographic metasurface antenna which can focus the radiation microwaves at 5.8GHz band is proposed in this paper. Simulation results show that the proposed antenna has a good impedance matching and excellent focusing ability as predicted. The proposed focusing method can pave the way to promising applications in MPT area, dramatical increasing the efficiencies.

articleTitle: A Dual-Polarized Omnidirectional Antenna with High Isolation for 2G/3G/LTE/5G Scenarios
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: This paper presents a dual polarized omnidirectional antenna with high isolation for 3G/LTE/5G scenarios. The antenna is comprised of two parts: a vertically polarized radiating element composed of 3 copper patches and a horizontally polarized radiating element composed of 4 printed dipoles and a four-way power divider. The overall profile height of the antenna is 0.3 λ<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</sub> (where λ<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</sub> is the starting wavelength). Simulation results show that the overlapped bandwidth between horizontal polarization (HP) and vertical polarization (VP) is 1.66-3.65 GHz, and the isolation is less than -42 dB. Moreover, low gain variations within 3 dB in both VP and HP directions can also be attained, which means good omni-directional characteristics.

articleTitle: Channel Model for RFID based Electronic Registration Identification of the motor vehicle in Practical Open Transportation Scenario
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Current researches on communication channel of electronic registration identification of the motor vehicle (ERI) are mostly based on the single lane two channel model, which is not consistent with the multi-lane multi-car scene in the practical application. In this paper, a channel model combined with deterministic and stochastic component is firstly proposed for ERI. The theoretical formula of the model is derived and simulated. The influence of Doppler shift on each transmission path in the channel model and the effect of adjacent lane reflection path on channel fading is analyzed in detail. The work of this paper is with great significance for evaluation of ERI system in practical scenario.

Author Keywords: Electronic Registration Identification of the motor vehicle (ERI)

articleTitle: The Accurate Actual-feed Illumination Technique for the Reflector Antenna
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: A shaping technique using the actual feed(AF) to illuminate the reflector antenna is proposed, which is compared with the conventional simulated feed(SF) after optimizing the reflector antenna patterns. The corresponding reflector shape is transformed by the non-uniform rational Bspline method, and its scattering field is gotten through the physical optics and Gauss-Legendre quadrature algorithms(PO-GLQ). The consequent calculated patterns by means of the actual feed are closer to the measured far-field ones than simulated feed.

articleTitle: Flexible Resistive Film Broadband FSS Absorber Suitable for a Variety of Curved Surfaces
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: This paper studies the changes in the absorbing performance and bandwidth of a resistive film absorber based on a square ring FSS unit structure and loaded on a flexible substrate material in the case of a finite plane and a variety of curved surfaces that are curved and conformal, so as to verify The feasibility of flexible broadband FSS absorber based on resistive film for any curved surface is discussed.

articleTitle: A Dual-Polarized Antenna Array for Base Station Applications
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: A dual-polarized antenna array for 4G base stations is presented in this paper. The antenna array is a 2×4 uniform planar array and is composed of printed dual-polarized dipole antennas, operating in 1.7-2.2 GHz. By loading the metal plate and using antenna decoupling surface, the mutual coupling of the array is below -20dB.

articleTitle: Wireless Channel Modeling, Simulation and Analysis for Electronic Registration Identification of Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Electronic registration identification (ERI) of the motor vehicle is an important application of passive radio frequency identification (RFID) in the field of intelligent transportation which has been put into use in some countries. ERI is in the pilot research stage now in China, but the release of the standard is accelerating its promotion. The performance evaluation of car-related RFID products is often accomplished by test and trial method currently. The test results are seriously affected by irrelevant environmental factors, making it impossible to carry out scientific repeatable experiments. In this paper, the communication channel model of ERI system in the highway traffic scene is modeled based on the ray tracing method. In order to accurately establish the model, we conducted a simulation analysis on the influence of factors such as antenna pattern, polarization mode, ground material, and environmental noise on the received signal power and tag reading distance. Files generated based on the model in this article can be loaded onto the channel simulator, so as to build an ERI test system with reproducible test results which has important application value.

articleTitle: Magnetically Controlled THz three-routing Switch based on Magnetic Photonic Crystals
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: We propose and numerically investigate magnetically controlled THz three-routing switch with highly switching contrast in two-dimensional photonic crystals, which introduced four waveguide defects and a square rod of ferrite material in the center of the structure. The four square rods around the ferrite are replaced with triangular rods to reduce the reflection of the incident wave. The maximum photonic band gap can be obtained by optimizing the side length and rotation angle of the square rods. The optical properties of system are investigated by finite element method. It demonstrates that the switching contrast is up to 45dB at the optimized operating frequency. In addition, magneto-optical materials with specific properties can be selected according to different wavelengths to realize optical functional devices of different bands. Therefore, it has great application prospect in the tunable and integrated optical devices.

articleTitle: Impact of Front-to-Rear Ratio, Side Lobe Level, and Beam Orientation of Base Station Antennas on MIMO Performance
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: As the device radiating and receiving electromagnetic waves, antennas play a vital role in the wireless communication technology. Therefore, the performance of antennas will greatly affect the performance of MIMO communication. In this paper, we study the effects of some common radiation characteristics of base station antennas, including front-to-rear ratio, side lobe level, and beam orientation, on the performance of cellular communication system. It is shown that the channel capacity increases as the front-to-rear ratio of the antenna element increases, but when the front-to-rear ratio reaches 20dB and above, the channel capacity basically remains unchanged. In addition, with the increase of the side lobe level and/or the offset of the beam orientation, the data rate of the multi-user multi-cell system decreases. This is mainly due to the increased interference.

articleTitle: A Novel Enhancement and Tracking Extraction Method of Bearing Fault Features for Rotating Machinery
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: The rolling bearing is one of the most important parts of rotating machinery. In the early stage of weak impact or the background of strong noise, the extraction of the fault features would become difficult. The extraction result of fault characteristics plays an important role in the accuracy of fault diagnosis. A novel enhancement and tracking extraction method combining minimum entropy deconvolution (MED) and Vold-Kalman filter (VKF) is presented in this manuscript. Experimental investigation of the 6205-2RS JEM SKF bearing with inner ring defects is performed. The experimental results prove that, by using the proposed method, the amplitude of the fault feature is almost twice as much as the healthy characteristic. The results show that the proposed extraction method can provide an excellent solution for fault diagnosis of rolling bears.

articleTitle: A Target Detection Method in SAR Images Based on Superpixel Segmentation
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: A synthetic aperture radar (SAR) target detection method based on the fusion of multiscale superpixel segmentations is proposed in this paper. SAR images are segmented between land and sea firstly by using superpixel technology in different scales. Secondly, image segmentation results together with the constant false alarm rate (CFAR) detection result are coalesced. Finally, target detection is realized by fusing different scale results. The effectiveness of the proposed algorithm is tested on Sentinel-1A data.

articleTitle: Ultra-Wideband MIMO Array Antenna New Decoupling Structure
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Based on the traditional monopole microstrip antenna, a dual-sector ultra-wideband MIMO array antenna is designed. The array consists of two ultra-wideband monopole antennas with the same structure, both of which are fed by microstrip lines. By smoothing the ground plate radiation patch and cutting out the rectangular groove, the impedance matching degree of the antenna is improved, the bandwidth range of the antenna is widened, and the normal operation in the frequency range of 2GHz~16GHz is finally realized. By adding a two-step structure on the back of the antenna and two symmetrical rectangular stubs on the front, the isolation of the antenna in the 2GHz~16GHz frequency range is lower than - 20dB, the highest gain can reach 11.6dB. Moreover, the radiation direction is almost full, and is suitable for UWB wireless communication systems.

articleTitle: Continuous Wavelength Characterization of 1.3µm Quantum Dot Mesa Diode
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In this experiment, we investigated 1.3um QD mesa diode with 8 layers of quantum dot in the active region sandwiched by n-type and p-type AIGaAs cladding layers in a variable composition of aluminium. This report shows the characteristics of QD laser in CW condition, which includes temperature, frequency and current density. From the diagrams, we can easily get turn on voltage, the wavelength of ground state, first excited state and second excited state respectively. We further investigated the reasons of causing these phenomena.

articleTitle: Broadband Ultra-thin Metasurface for High-Efficiency Polarization Conversion
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: This paper presents a novel metasurface for high-efficiency polarization conversion. Using element connection technique, the proposed metasurface has compact structure. Its element size is only 0.15λ×0.15λ×0.076λ. The polarization conversion bandwidth is 97.3% with efficiency above 90%.

articleTitle: A Target Selection Method for the MMW Seeker Based on Tracking Preserving
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Focusing on the problem of target selection under complex land battlefield, a method using tracking preserving is proposed in this paper. Firstly, target position obtained by the fire control system is stored by the missile-borne computer. And then, target pointing of the MMW seeker is calculated in real time during the missile flight to improve target capturing probability. In the end, target position obtained by the seeker will be compared to the one obtained by the fire-control system, realizing accurate choice of the threatening target for the MMW seeker. Experimental results have verified the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: A Dual-Band Metal-Rimmed Smartphone Antenna
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: A simple dual-band antenna utilizing chip inductor is presented for metal-rimmed smartphones. The proposed antenna primarily consists of a rectangular ground plane and a metal rim, in which a ring slot is arranged between the metal ground and the rim. A U-shaped slot antenna operating at GSM900 band is designed by loading two grounded stubs. A simple matching circuit is added on the upper section of the antenna. Afterwards, two chip inductors are placed along the top metal-rim to form a T-shaped monopole working at WLAN 5.8GHz band. The simulated results demonstrate the feasibility of the proposed design, and its operating band covers the GSM band from 870 MHz to 980 MHz and WLAN band from 5.2 GHz to 7 GHz.

articleTitle: Multi-Feature Extraction and Fusion Method for Pedestrian Re-identification
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Pedestrian re-identification is to identify the target interested from pedestrian images taken by multiple cameras. Recently, the ReID (Person re-identification) algorithm has shown that the local features of pedestrians are used to describe various parts of the body, the global features of pedestrians are used to represent the overall information, and the local features of relationships are used to make certain connections between local features to form more discriminative features. Although these algorithms have a certain effect on pedestrian re-identification, their recognition accuracy is still not satisfactory. To solve these problems, we propose a novel multi-feature extraction fusion model (MFEFM). It can extract three different features of pedestrian images at the same time and merge them together to form a more discriminative feature. First, use ResNet-50 as the infrastructure to extract basic features. Then, global maximum pooling (GMP) is used to extract local features of pedestrian images, global average pooling (GAP) is used to extract global features, and pose-estimator is used to extract key point features in parallel. Finally, we use the relationship network to form connected local features and key point features, and then connect these three features together.

articleTitle: A Novel Miniature Conical Conformal Beidou antenna for High-shock Projectile Applications
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Aiming at the application of high-overload projectiles, this letter proposes a new type of miniaturized conical conformal Beidou antenna with right-hand circular polarization (RHCP) characteristic. The radiation patch and the ground plane of the proposed antenna are printed on the outer and inner surface of a hollow conical substrate. The inner wall of the substrate is metallized as the ground plane, so that the antenna performance will not be affected by the equipment installed in the internal space. The introduction of short ring and substrate with high dielectric constant makes the proposed antenna achieve miniaturization feature. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed antenna can receive signals from eight satellites and provide stable signal reception.

articleTitle: Research on Frontier Issues of New Generation Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: With the outbreak of the New coronavirus pneumonia epidemic, artificial intelligence plays an important enabling effect in helping to prevent and control the epidemic. It has been half a century since artificial intelligence was proposed. Besides, its development process has experienced “three ups and two downs”. In this paper, CiteSpace, patent mining and other analysis methods are used to conduct an in-depth analysis of the two cutting-edge issues that exist in the key core technologies of artificial intelligence and the Artificial intelligence question and answer mode. It has found that computer vision technology, natural language processing technology and brain-computer interface technology have become the focus of artificial intelligence research. From the perspective of the number of key core technology patents, intelligent chip technology and computer vision technology are the key research and development objects. The Artificial intelligence question and answer mode are mainly reflected in the change of interactive mode and its intelligence, in which core technologies and key algorithms are the focus. Finally, based on the exploration of frontier issues, we find a breakthrough in the development of artificial intelligence in China, so as to have a certain voice in the new round of international competition and provide relevant decision-making reference for China's construction of a new generation of artificial intelligence innovation development experimental zones and innovation platforms.

articleTitle: A Joint Calibration Method for Array Gain-phase Errors and Mutual Coupling Errors
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Combining the search depth of particle swarm optimization (PSO) algorithm and the search breadth of invasive weed optimization (IWO) algorithm, an offline algorithm, based on IWO-PSO for joint correction of gain-phase errors and mutual coupling errors, is proposed. Firstly, a known auxiliary source is used to establish an objective function containing both gain-phase errors and mutual coupling errors, and then the IWO-PSO algorithm is used to search for those array errors satisfying the optimal values of the objective function through an alternating iteration procedure. The proposed method does not need prior knowledge of array perturbations, and has good estimation performance of DOA and array errors. Compared with other calibration methods based on optimization algorithms, the RMSE curve of the proposed method for DOA estimation is closer to CRB curve.

articleTitle: Absorbing Structure Design of Planar Spiral Antenna for Improving Multipath Effect
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: A new absorbing structure based on a planar spiral antenna is designed to deal with multipath propagation in a complex urban environment. Firstly, a multipath propagation model is introduced, and then a specific size metal ring structure is designed for multipath signals, and the final wave-absorbing structure is obtained through improvement and optimization. In this paper, emphasis on the value of the phase and the root mean square error of the antenna received by multipath signals of different angles and frequencies under the absorbing structure. The simulation results verify its effectiveness.

articleTitle: Prediction Analysis of the Signal Coverage from Multi-antenna System
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: This paper proposes a signal covering analysis method for multi-channel RFID system to improve the detecting efficiency and accuracy for the moving tags. A program is developed for the prediction analysis of the field intensity in the working space and used for the optimal installations of the reading antennas. In the application for the design of a four-channel RFID system, the calculated field intensity analysis matches well with the simulated results and gives the optimal installation coordinates for the four antennas with a satisfaction of the detecting sensitivity.

articleTitle: Metagrating for Single Order Diffraction with High Efficiency Based on Bianisotropic Particles
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: A novel metagrating is proposed to achieve single order diffraction. The proposed unit has electric and magnetic hybrid response. The unit is composed of asymmetrical patch. By introducing magnetic response, the element will break the symmetry of diffraction. One of the first order diffraction is canceled and the energy is totally reflected into the other order at 10GHz. Besides, the diffraction efficiency is higher than 80% from 9.4GHz to 11.1GHz. The simulated far field pattern shows good agreement with prediction. The proposed design provide a highly efficient method to suppress 0 and +1 order diffraction and simplify the difficulty of design, paving the way for further applications of beam steering.

articleTitle: Broadband Dual-polarization Dual-dipole Filter Antenna Applied to Base Station
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: This paper proposes a dual-polarized dual-dipole filter antenna for base station applications. The antenna is mainly composed of five parts: radiator, parasitic elements, open-ended stubs, feeding baluns, and reflector. In the antenna design, the parasitic element and the open-ended stubs are directly connected to the low-frequency radiator, and the decoupling between different frequency bands is realized by using the characteristics of out-of-band suppression of the filter antenna. The simulation results show that the introduction of the filter unit on the low-frequency radiation unit tremendously reduces the distortion of the high-frequency array pattern caused by the existence of the high order modes of the low-frequency antenna. The antenna array consists of two rows of high-frequency antennas with a working frequency of 1.7-2.3 GHz and a row of low-frequency antennas with a working frequency of 0.8-1.08 GHz that are alternately arranged. This proposed design achieves good filtering performance and alleviates the pattern distortion.

articleTitle: Microwave sensor based on complementary circular spiral resonator for non-destructive testing of cracks in dielectric plate
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: A microwave sensor inspired by the complementary circular spiral resonant structure is designed in this paper for the non-destructive testing of dielectric material plate. The sensor is designed based on the complementary circular spiral resonator (CCSR) which has two resonance frequencies in the considered frequency band. Frequency shift and variation of S<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">11</sub> parameter is observed when the sensor is put over materials under testing (MUT). This also happens when the cracks exist in the sample. This phenomenon can be applied for the non-destructive testing of the cracks existing in the dielectric plates. Numerical results are given in the paper for a detailed discussion of the variation of the resonance frequencies and the S<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">11</sub> parameter for different MUT and the orientations of the cracks.

articleTitle: Analysis of a Trembling Hand Game on Parallel Machines
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In this work, we study the problem of n users assigning load to m identical machines with the restriction that there is a small probability that users may accidentally choose unintended strategies. This problem we describe as selfish load balancing games with trembling hand users. We systematically study the pure Nash equilibria of the variants we proposed and a comparison of those equilibria and optimum allocation related to the social cost. For our basic variant, we present as chief outcome, a proof of existence of pure Nash equilibria in our trembling hand game on identical machines when taking limited values of probability. Moreover, through similar analysis of general upper bound on pure price of anarchy, we derive that the bound in our case is a function of the probability.

articleTitle: Broadband High-Gain Aperture-Coupled Patch Antenna Array Based on SIW for 60 GHz Applications
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In this paper, a wideband high-gain aperture-coupled antenna (ACPA) array based on substrate integrated waveguide (SIW), and microstrip line feeding is described at the 60 GHz unlicensed frequency spectrum. From the simulated results, the bandwidth and gain enhanced by four-elements microstrip patch antenna is utilized as a radiating element, which shows impedance bandwidth (|S11| <; -10 dB) and maximum gain of 33.8% and 13.1 dBi from 50 GHz to 72 GHz, respectively. Besides, a 4×4 array designed with 16-way T-junction by SIW power divider feeding network achieves a bandwidth of 29% and peak gain of 25 dBi.

articleTitle: Digital Modeling Simulation System of Agile Satellite Operation State
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Agile satellite has the characteristics of strong autonomy and flexibility in on orbit mission control, high requirements for accurate imaging control and outstanding imaging ability in motion. By analyzing the characteristics of four main imaging modes of agile satellite, including strip push broom, agile imaging, area scanning and gaze tracking, and the constraints of on orbit work, the digital modeling and simulation system of remote sensing satellite operation state is constructed. It includes nine models, including imaging arc model, attitude control model and observation direction model. The results show that the digital modeling and simulation system of remote sensing satellite operation state can accurately simulate the whole process and all elements of the four imaging modes. Compared with STK simulation results, the time error of strip imaging center points are within ± 0.015 seconds. The system can provide simulation analysis for satellite design and support mission management and control of satellite on orbit operation.

articleTitle: Improving Field Uniformity Using Beam Deflection with Metasurface in a Reverberation Chamber
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: The metasurface can provide beam deflection by providing phase gradient. In this work, a single-layer small size transmission-type metasurface is used to generate a deflect beam in the transmission and reflection directions at the same time, as the transmission coefficients of the meta-lens is 0.5 at the resonant frequency. This metasurface is introduced for reverberation chamber (RC) measurements, which can provide 8 irrelevant states in our experiment, and the results show that the field uniformity of the RC can be improved effectively.

articleTitle: Spherical Convolution Matched Layer in Cartesian Coordinate System for the FDTD Solver
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Spherical truncation boundary in non-spherical coordinate system for the finite-difference time-domain (FDTD) method is discussed in this paper. The convolutional perfectly matched layer has been optimized in non-physical division and enhanced weakly ability in absorbing evanescent wave. From the radiation simulation, we found that the wave profile only according to simulation time, which leads to spherical outline in three dimensional cases. We reconstruct regular cubic Yee cells in three-dimensional, and restricts computation domain in the spherical truncation boundary. This method effectively avoids the unnecessary computation in corner and edge areas, and greatly reduces the memory and running time. This is an essentially efficient modeling strategy, which is suitable for the FDTD method in solving three dimensional scattering problems.

articleTitle: A Compact Dual-Polarized Differentially-Fed Antenna with High Gain for 5G Microcells
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: A compact dual-polarized differentially-fed antenna with high gain is proposed for 5G microcells. The antenna mainly consists of two parts: a radiating element with metasurface and a differentially-fed network. The metasurface with four square cells is etched on the top layer, while the radiating octagonal patch etched with four fan-shaped slots is placed on the second layer. The profile of the antenna is 0.125 λ<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</sub> (where λ<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</sub> is the starting wavelength). Simulation results show that the overlapped bandwidths are 3.30-3.61 GHz and 4.72-5.07 GHz, and their corresponding gains vary from 8.30 to 9.65 dBi.

articleTitle: A Sparsely Six-arm Spiral Phased array antenna for W-band applications
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In this paper, a sparsely phased array antenna based on six-arm spiral arrangement is proposed for W-band applications. The proposed antenna element consists of a double-layered stacked patch fed by coaxial probe. In order to reduce the element number of the antenna array while maintaining wide scanning angle and low sidelobe, a six-arm array configuration is developed as a substitution of the conventional rectangular array. A prototype of the six-arm spiral array is simulated at 94GHz band. The simulation results exhibit a maximum gain of 28.5dBi with a scanning angle of 30°. By using the six-arm spiral array design, the proposed antenna can achieve 30 degree scanning range with gain loss less than 1.6dB.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of Single Link OAM Communication System
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: The Orbital Angular Momentum (OAM) is one of the intrinsic properties carried by vortex electromagnetic wave, and it can be applied to future communication systems. In this paper, a single OAM communication link model is built, and corresponding performances are analyzed and simulated. Simulation results shows that the OAM can be used for actual communications.

articleTitle: A Distributed Stream Data Processing Platform Design and Implementation in Smart Cities
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: The existence of bounded data and unbounded data gives a great challenge for data processing in smart cities. The wide application of the internet of things (IoT) makes the data amount rapidly increase. This leads to further raise the requirement for data processing in smart cities, especially the demand for low latency and abundant data in real-time video services. To solve this problem, a Flink based framework with smart city adaption is proposed. A mathematical model for data processing in smart cities is formulated. Through this model's solution, the path with the minimum resource occupancy ratio (ROR) is obtained. The superiority and feasibility of our work are validated via numerical simulation and prototype implementation, respectively.

articleTitle: Design of Parallelly Concatenated Spatially Coupled RA Codes
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In this paper, parallelly concatenated spatially coupled RA (PC-SCRA) codes was presented based on spatially coupled RA (SCRA) codes with the advantages of simple coding structure, threshold saturation and low decoding complexity. When encoding, the same message bits are respectively encoded by two same SCRA codes to obtain respective check bits. During transmission, the message bits and the obtained parity bits are merged into one codeword for transmission. Besides, density evolution algorithm was proposed to compute the iterative decoding threshold of PC-SCRA code ensemble over the binary erasure channel. Simulation results show that the proposed PC-SCRA code ensemble has excellent BP threshold performance close to Shannon limit and is superior to the spatially coupled LDPC (SC-LDPC) code with same coderate, which provides a new way for construrting capacity-approaching SC-LDPC codes.
